name: The Orchid Show 2026: Christian Sampson
blurb: Selby Gardens' signature fall exhibition fills its bayfront conservatory with orchid installations by artist Christian Sampson. Admission is $28 for adults, $12 for ages 5–17, and free for members and kids 4 and under.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Sarasota Magazine

name: Ahoy-Hoy by Jenny Stafford
hours_label: Wed–Sat 7:30 PM · Wed & Sun 2 PM · $52 ($32 under 40)
blurb: Urbanite Theatre, downtown Sarasota's intimate home for bold new plays, stages Jenny Stafford's Ahoy-Hoy. Standard tickets are $52, $32 for patrons under 40, and $5 for students with ID.

name: Sarasota Medieval Fair
venue: Woods of Mallaranny at Mallaranny Farms (East Sarasota County)
hours_label: Sat & Sun 10 AM – 5:30 PM · Tickets from about $17
blurb: The 21st-anniversary Sarasota Medieval Fair brings jousting knights, costumed performers, artisans and turkey legs to a wooded farm east of Sarasota on weekends through early December. Tickets start around $17 and are sold online at the fair's website.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
venue: Siesta Beach (south of the main pavilion)
hours_label: About 4:30 PM until sunset (~5:37 PM) · Free
blurb: Every Sunday for decades, drummers and dancers have gathered on the powder-white sand of Siesta Beach to drum the sun down over the Gulf. It's free, family-friendly and open to all — bring a drum or just a beach chair and soak in one of Siesta Key's most iconic traditions.
